svg.text: Cafeteria, hall and yard: one connected module (plan, to scale)
Proposal. Two clear axes from the spawn door: north to the reactor, west to the mine. Red ticks = doors and openings. Furniture is representative; counts and triangle costs are in the budget sheet.
to reactor: 34 m spine, 75 m clear sightline
mine axis: 40 m across the yard to the portal
